system.summary: Graphic-sign simple substitution of English, words divided, a few homophones (d/u share a sign, a/g), single signs for persons (9, n, pound sign), inserted as runs in clear English.
system.notes: Same key in all six letters, 1592 and 1594, in two hands.

prior_solution.where: DECODE Non-decrypted; no decipherment on leaves; Birch 1749 does not print the passages; Butler, Edmondes Papers (1913) located (HathiTrust mdp.39015083993017) but blocked, unchecked; List and Analysis SP Foreign 1591-94 not accessible

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie, Claude Code set-up, the problem posed with /goal; said 'continue' after a subagent was blocked.

solution.what: Fetched 24 page images and record metadata for R7770-R7775 from DECODE with the session cookie.
Metadata 'author: Lord Threr?' read as the addressee; BL catalogue identifies Stowe MS 166 as Edmondes's papers.
Searched Birch 1749 (archive.org text) for the passages; Butler 1913 blocked (HathiTrust 403).
f. 50: frequent words taken as the/of/to; then 'difficulties', 'empeachement' on f. 109v fixed most letters.
Subagent read f. 50 in full (marriage of the King's sister, person signs 9 and n); it was blocked by auto mode before the other pages.
Read f. 57, f. 58v, f. 60v, f. 109v, f. 112 from line crops with the key.
Four cipher lines on f. 59 attempted; only fragments.

Print check: Butler, Edmondes Papers (1913) located as HathiTrust full view mdp.39015083993017 (record 002098089), but ssd/pt/full-text search blocked by Cloudflare 403 after one page (curl, PowerShell, WebFetch); Google Books 4sJCAQAAMAAJ captcha, Books API over quota; not on archive.org. List and Analysis of State Papers Foreign 1591-94 in copyright, BHO premium only; not searched.

outcome.method_basis: The simple substitution was broken from frequent cipher words guessed as 'the', 'of', 'to' and then 'difficulties', 'empeachement' on f. 109v, with no printed or glossed plaintext (Butler 1913 not reached).

gaps.detail: NOTES record only fragments and give no cause (no damage or illegibility noted); no documented second pass with the full key
person signs; 9 = Soissons? and £ = Guise? by context only, n and 4̇ unidentified

outcome.notes: All passages read except four lines on f. 59; person signs 9 (Soissons?), n, pound (Guise?) unconfirmed. fraction_read estimated from NOTES: 4 of about 35 cipher lines (f. 59) unread, plus 3-4 unconfirmed person signs; no token count file.
outcome.fraction_read_source: no reading or transcription file; NOTES give readings in prose, so tokens cannot be counted (estimate: 4 of ~35 cipher lines unread)
